finding.expected: Mirror the frozen collector interactive-ancestry semantics exactly for the collector_eligible_candidate_count observation: button, role=button, a, select and input. Do not treat onclick-only ancestry as collector-equivalent unless exposed under a separately named non-authoritative diagnostic observation. Add deterministic regression covering button, role-button, link, select, input, ordinary div and onclick-only ancestry. Preserve zero raw price persistence, no scalar admission and all TASK-251 authority closures.
finding.issue: The V5 field collector_eligible_candidate_count is observationally inconsistent with the frozen collector predicate it is intended to explain. The production collector excludes ancestry under tag button, role=button, tag a, tag select or tag input. The new diagnostic predicate instead includes onclick and, apart from the unresolved isCtrl call, does not explicitly mirror link/select/input ancestry. This can classify a candidate as collector-eligible or ineligible differently from the byte-unchanged collector and weaken the diagnostic's ability to explain why current-price admission remained unknown.
